scope: Delivery proofs must remain bound to the current persisted EditionManifest identity

evidence.red: invalidates a proof when the persisted edition manifest is replaced
evidence.command: npm.cmd --prefix api test -- src/deliveryProof.spec.ts src/editionManifest.spec.ts src/releasePreflight.spec.ts

boundary: A proof whose persisted manifest is missing, replaced, or cross-bound is invalid and cannot be used as delivery evidence.
